prerequisites.title: Public website and privacy policy
prerequisites.detail: The home page must be public, and the privacy policy must be on the same domain and say how you access, use, store or share Google user data.

prerequisites.title: A domain you can verify
prerequisites.detail: Domains tied to your consent screen and credentials must be verified in Google Search Console.

prerequisites.title: Organization-owned project for internal use
prerequisites.detail: The project must be owned by your organization with an Internal user type.

steps.title: Create Cloud project and consent screen
steps.detail: Open the Google Auth platform Branding page and enter app name, logo, support email and links. Choose Internal for s1, External otherwise.
inputs: Home page and privacy policy URLs

steps.title: Choose the narrowest Gmail scopes
steps.detail: Draft the scope list and a written reason why each sensitive scope needs more than a narrower one.
steps.done_when: Scopes are declared on the Data Access page with justifications ready.

steps.title: Verify domains in Search Console
steps.detail: Verify every authorized domain, including the domain used for the redirect URI.

steps.title: Set up redirect through your domain
steps.detail: Write a proxy endpoint on your domain that returns a 302 redirect to Composio's callback. Register that endpoint as the redirect URI.
steps.done_when: The proxy redirects the browser with a 302.

steps.title: Create OAuth client in Google
steps.detail: Create a Web application client with the redirect URI and copy the client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: You hold the client ID and secret.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a Gmail auth config through Composio's API using your own client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and a test connection works.

steps.title: Record the demo video
steps.detail: Show the OAuth grant, the consent screen with app name, and the feature each sensitive scope enables.
steps.done_when: The video is ready to upload.

steps.title: Verify and publish branding
steps.detail: Click Verify Branding, then publish within 7 days. Do not edit branding while verification runs.

steps.title: Submit data access verification
steps.detail: Submit the justifications and video in the verification dialog and answer follow-up emails.

steps.title: Wait for Google verification
steps.detail: Scope verification typically takes 3-5 business days. Brand verification may take 2-3 business days if it goes to manual review.

traps.title: In testing, the app still shows a tester warning
traps.detail: In testing, the app still shows a tester warning screen, a user cap is in effect, and the refresh token lifetime is limited.

traps.title: Restricted scopes add a security assessment
traps.detail: gmail.readonly is restricted. A security assessment is required if restricted data is stored on servers or transmitted.

traps.title: Unverified apps cap at 100 users
traps.detail: A published unverified app with sensitive or restricted scopes shows warnings and allows 100 total users. Google also applies a new-user authorization rate limit.

traps.title: Composio's callback domain cannot be verified by you
traps.detail: Google requires verification of redirect URI domains, and you do not own backend.composio.dev. Route the callback through your own domain with a 302 redirect.

traps.title: Testing mode is not production
traps.detail: Testing apps allow up to 100 test users and refresh tokens expire after 7 days.

traps.title: Brand check result expires after 7 days
traps.detail: If you do not publish within 7 days, you must re-verify. Branding edits are blocked during verification.

traps.title: Customer admins have the last word
traps.detail: Workspace admins can block or limit any app, even a verified one.

traps.title: Managed app shows Composio's name
traps.detail: Users see 'Composio wants to access your account', with default scopes and shared quota.

blockers.symptom: Users see an unverified-app warning or hit the user cap
blockers.what_it_means: Your app is not verified for its scopes.
blockers.what_to_do: Finish brand and scope verification, and answer Trust & Safety emails.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft justifications and check the home page and privacy policy against the requirements.

blockers.what_it_means: The new-user authorization rate limit was reached.
blockers.what_to_do: Request a quota increase; Google says to expect a response in 5 business days.
